subject: hid-playstation: fix warning.
author: Sorgelig

upstream.vanilla_file_line: drivers/hid/hid-playstation.c:2131-2132 (`hid_err(...); goto err_free;`) and :2152 (the `err_free:` label) in linux-6.18.52 -- vanilla still has BOTH, so vanilla is warning-free; the dangling label exists only on trees that took the MiSTer DS4 change

provenance_doc_ref: records/5c410e935d4f9743d9d71a0d0d796258544eba91.json is the 5.15 origin of the DS4 change this label belongs to; docs/patch-provenance.md class D (the hid-sony -> hid-playstation retarget).

impact.effect_if_absent: A -Wunused-label warning on drivers/hid/hid-playstation.c at build time. Nothing else: the label is unreferenced, so it generates no code and its presence changes no behaviour. On OUR image: no effect -- the label has been gone since the 5.15->6.18 forward port of 0022 on 2026-07-12, two months before the fork removed it.

forward_port.effort: none -- nothing to port; the change is already the state of our tree

notes:
THE FORK CAUGHT UP WITH US. This commit deletes the now-unreferenced `err_free:` label from dualshock4_get_mac_address(), which became dangling on the fork when its own port of the MiSTer DS4 non-fatal-pairing-info change replaced `goto err_free;` with `ret = 0;` and left the label behind. Our 0022 removed the label in the SAME edit that made the read non-fatal, on 2026-07-12 -- 0022's own Forward-port block says so verbatim: 'Removed the resulting unreferenced `err_free:` label (-Wunused-label) now that nothing gotos it.' So there is nothing to backport; the disposition is carried, with 0022 named, and the record exists to say why the queue entry is already closed.

MEASURED, not assumed: `git show c129b0fac:drivers/hid/hid-playstation.c` (the parent) does have a bare `err_free:` above `kfree(buf); return ret;` with no `goto err_free;` left anywhere in the function, and the de10nano series applied to pristine 6.18.52 produces a dualshock4_get_mac_address() with no label at all.

ONE REMAINING DIFFERENCE, unrelated to this commit and deliberately kept: on the failed ps_get_report() our 0022 logs `hid_warn(hdev, "Failed to retrieve DualShock4 pairing info: %d; continuing without it\n", ret)` where the fork still logs the original `hid_err(hdev, "Failed to retrieve DualShock4 pairing info: %d\n", ret)`. Ours is the honest level for a path that then sets `ret = 0` and continues -- an error message followed by a successful probe reads as a bug in the log. Recorded here so the next tree-diff does not re-discover it as an unexplained delta; it is NOT a candidate to send upstream on its own (docs/kernel-recon/fork-sync-2026-09/upstream-candidates/ already holds the ones worth sending).

First commit in this queue authored by Sorgelig rather than arriving as a PR, and the only one of the six that did not originate in this repo.
